meta.window: per video, first eligible30 event: [clear_start, onset] seconds (S_audio candidates: 0 to first onset); holdout: 0 to first onset or whole clip when no onset

features.music_frac: fraction of valid seconds with AST Music sigmoid > 0.5
features.words: words in non-overlapping (every 6th) accepted Whisper windows (text_en)
features.sport: per-100-words hits of sports play-by-play regex
features.rms_mean/std: audio_dsp rms_db_mean mean and std over window

order: silent_absent: fewer than 5 valid seconds or valid fraction < 0.4 (conf 0.95 / 0.8); or rms_mean < -50 dB with vad < 0.05 and music < 0.3

no or little speech (words < 15 or vad_frac < 0.15): music if music_frac >= 0.5 (conf 0.65-0.8), mixed if 0.25-0.5, else diegetic ambient (conf 0.55; 0.4 when AST speech-like > 0.5 but nothing transcribed)
xd_movie: scripted soundtrack, never diegetic; music if music >= 0.5 and vad < 0.4 else mixed
speech with music >= 0.5 and vad < 0.4: music
narration: I_rate <= 3.5 and prof < 0.5 (conf 0.8 if news >= 1.5 or sport >= 2.5 or (vad >= 0.6 and rms_std < 6), else 0.65)
rules.music_bed: music >= 0.5 with vad >= 0.4 does not force music; flagged in evidence

caveats: Lexical rules are crude; diegetic vs mixed is the weakest boundary, talking-head vlogger monologues and streamer talk look diegetic by text
AST Narration class almost never fires (max sigmoid mean < 0.1) so it is not used
Labels are for the pre-onset window only
transcripts have language mix; non-English windows use the MT English text
